This all reads cleanly and matches the repo's conventions. Everything is verified and complete.

## Summary

Implemented A4 per `.studio-run/prompts/A4.md`:

- **`convex/creditPacks.ts`** (new): `listPacks({ kind? })` public query (filters `isActive`, sorted by `sortOrder`), `getPackBySlug`, and admin-only `upsertPack` / `setPackActive` mutations, all built on the `creditPacks` schema from A1.
- **`convex/seed.ts`**: added `seedCreditPacks`, an idempotent (upsert-by-slug) mutation seeding the 5 locked rows (basic, premium, starter, creator, pro), guarded by the same `requireSyncSecret` pattern as the existing seed function — written with `mutation` from `_generated/server` per repo convention (not `mutationGeneric`).
- **`convex/creditPacks.test.ts`** (new): 5 tests covering idempotent seeding, active/sorted listing, `kind` filtering, admin protection, and upsert-not-duplicate behavior.

All three gates are green: `npx convex codegen`, `npm run lint` (0 errors, same 7 pre-existing warnings), `npm run test` (25 files / 136 tests, up from 24/132).

No production actions were taken (no deploy, no Stripe calls, no env vars set). `stripePriceId` was left empty as instructed — the exact list of 5 slugs Jovan needs to wire up in Stripe is written into `docs/STUDIO-PROGRESS.md` under the A4 entry, along with the decisions made (mutation style choice, seed overwrite semantics, `getPackBySlug` not filtering by `isActive`, and no extra validation in `upsertPack`).
